pages.text: 春天的下午，阳光暖暖的。咘咘和NOMI、NONO、Coco在小花园里一起玩。花儿开了，蝴蝶飞来飞去，大家都好开心呀！
pages.text_en: On a warm spring afternoon, Bubu was playing in the little garden with NOMI, NONO, and Coco. Flowers were blooming and butterflies were fluttering. Everyone was so happy!

pages.text: 突然，咘咘「呸」的一声，往地上吐了一口口水。然后她低头看着地上的口水，抬起小脚丫，踩上去踩来踩去。「嘻嘻，好好玩！」
pages.text_en: Suddenly, Bubu spat on the ground — "Ptoo!" Then she looked down at the spit, lifted her little foot, and started stepping on it back and forth. "Hee hee, so fun!"

pages.text: NOMI皱起了眉头，轻轻蹲下来说：「咘咘，这样不好哦……地上脏脏的，吐口水不卫生呢。」
pages.text_en: NOMI frowned and gently knelt down. "Bubu, that's not good... The ground is dirty. Spitting is not hygienic."

pages.text: NONO扑棱棱飞到旁边的花枝上，小嘴巴撅着说：「呀，脏脏的！NONO不喜欢！NONO要飞走啦！」
pages.text_en: NONO fluttered to a nearby flower branch, pouting. "Eww, yucky! NONO doesn't like it! NONO is flying away!"

pages.text: Coco也往后退了一步，摇摇头说：「Oh no, that's not nice, Bubu! Spitting is yucky!」
pages.text_en: Coco also stepped back and shook her head. "Oh no, that's not nice, Bubu! Spitting is yucky!"

pages.text: 咘咘抬起头，发现大家都走开了。小花园里只剩下她一个人。咘咘的嘴巴扁了扁，眼睛红红的：「大家……都不跟咘咘玩了吗？」
pages.text_en: Bubu looked up and found everyone had moved away. She was all alone in the little garden. Her lip trembled and her eyes turned red. "Does... nobody want to play with Bubu anymore?"

pages.text: 这时候，妈妈走过来，温柔地抱起咘咘：「咘咘，吐口水不卫生哦。地上有很多小细菌，踩了口水，鞋子也会脏脏的。」
pages.text_en: Just then, Mama came over and gently picked Bubu up. "Bubu, spitting is not clean. There are lots of tiny germs on the ground. If you step on spit, your shoes will get dirty too."

pages.text: 爸爸也蹲下来，摸摸咘咘的头：「而且呀，别人看到吐口水会不舒服的。就像咘咘看到脏东西也会『哎呀』一样。」
pages.text_en: Papa also knelt down and patted Bubu's head. "And you know, other people feel uncomfortable when they see spitting. Just like how you say 'eww' when you see something dirty."

pages.text: 咘咘想了想，认认真真地点点头：「咘咘知道了……吐口水脏脏的，大家会不开心。咘咘不吐了！」
pages.text_en: Bubu thought about it and nodded earnestly. "Bubu understands... Spitting is dirty, and it makes everyone unhappy. Bubu won't do it anymore!"

pages.text: NOMI笑着走回来牵起咘咘的手，NONO飞回咘咘头顶，Coco也跑过来说：「Yay! Let's play together again!」大家又在一起啦！
pages.text_en: NOMI smiled and came back to hold Bubu's hand. NONO flew back to Bubu's head, and Coco ran over saying, "Yay! Let's play together again!" Everyone was together again!

pages.text: 过了一会儿，咘咘嘴巴里又想「呸」一下……但是她忍住了！咘咘把小嘴巴紧紧抿住，自己对自己说：「不可以！」
pages.text_en: A little while later, Bubu felt like spitting again... But she held it in! She pressed her lips tight and told herself, "No, I can't!"

pages.text: 大家都看到了，一起鼓掌！NOMI说「咘咘好棒！」NONO唱「棒棒棒！」Coco竖起大拇指：「Good job, Bubu! I'm so proud of you!」爸爸妈妈抱着咘咘笑得好开心。咘咘也笑了，因为她知道——不吐口水，大家都喜欢和她玩！
pages.text_en: Everyone saw it and clapped together! NOMI said, "Bubu, you're amazing!" NONO sang, "Bravo bravo!" Coco gave a thumbs up: "Good job, Bubu! I'm so proud of you!" Papa and Mama hugged Bubu with big smiles. Bubu smiled too, because she knew — when she doesn't spit, everyone loves playing with her!
